summary: Iter45 - Frontend verification of DriverProfilePage Support section + 6 DriverSupportPage subroutes + new chauffeur splash logo. All UI rendering, navigation, testids, FAQ expand, chat send/reply simulation, back button, row-click navigation, and logout flow PASS. Splash logo correctly uses /sb-logo-new.jpg. CRITICAL backend-integration bug: Contact form POST to /api/admin/crud/contact_requests returns 403 Forbidden for a driver session (endpoint is admin-only via require_role(['admin'])), but the frontend silently ignores the failed status and shows a misleading 'Message envoye !' success toast - message is NOT persisted in DB.

critical.issue: Returns 403 Forbidden when called from a driver (non-admin) session. admin.py line 251 uses require_role(request,['admin']). Driver contact form payload is dropped server-side -> no DB insertion. UI falsely reports success.

ui_bugs.issue: handleSendContact never checks fetch response.ok; on 403/500 it still calls toast.success('Message envoye !'). User believes message was sent when it was rejected. Should check resp.ok and toast.error otherwise.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend calls admin-only endpoint; either backend must expose a public /api/contact-requests or /api/support/contact for authenticated drivers/users, or require_role must be relaxed to ['admin','driver','user']. Currently driver contact form is broken end-to-end.

action_items: Fix driver contact form persistence: either (a) add a new POST /api/support/contact endpoint open to authenticated users+drivers that inserts into admin_contact_requests, or (b) loosen require_role on admin/crud/contact_requests POST to allow non-admin roles. Preferred: option (a) so the admin CRUD endpoint stays admin-only.
Add response.ok check in DriverSupportPage.handleSendContact; on failure call toast.error('Erreur d envoi') instead of toast.success - currently hides all server failures.
(Low) 404 console errors on profile page come from background calls (wallet/my-activity) for the freshly-created driver without a wallet/activity row - non-blocking but noisy.
critical_code_review_comments: DriverSupportPage.handleSendContact: uses try/catch on fetch() which only catches network errors - 4xx/5xx responses are silently treated as success. Always check resp.ok.

DriverProfilePage.ProfileRow: data-testid is label-derived and sliced at 25 chars - two Gift rows ('Envoyer une carte-cadeau' and 'Echanger une carte-cadeau') generate testids 'profile-row-envoyer-une-carte-cadeau' and 'profile-row-echanger-une-carte-cadeau' (ok in this case but brittle; consider explicit ids).

DriverProfilePage is 312 lines with ActivityCard + StatCell + ProfileRow + DriverBottomNav all co-located - approaching split threshold; extracting ProfileRow/DriverBottomNav into components/driver/ would aid reuse (DriverSupportPage already imports DriverBottomNav from DriverProfilePage which is an awkward cross-import).

/api/admin/crud/* is a generic admin CRUD being called from end-user UI (contact_requests). Suggest dedicated public endpoints for user-facing writes (contact, sos) so admin CRUD remains strictly admin.
AuthContext Google login flow from /chauffeur path still creates role='user' (flagged in iter44) - not re-verified here but still open.

success_rate.frontend: 100% UI rendering + nav, contact-send integration FAILING

test_credentials: Driver created at runtime via POST /api/auth/phone-register with role=driver (random +336######## phone, password Driver123!). Sample from this run: phone +33672458996 / Driver123! / id user_4e3accda1367. admin: admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123!
seed_data_creation: 1 test driver user created via phone-register per run (no cleanup endpoint). Low impact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend side of Iter45 fully validated: all data-testids exist (driver-profile-page, profile-name, wallet-card, profile-row-*, logout-btn, support-back, driver-support-{about|privacy|terms|faq|chat|contact}, faq-0..4, chat-messages, chat-input, chat-send, contact-message, contact-send). Splash /chauffeur uses /sb-logo-new.jpg via [data-testid=chauffeur-splash-logo]. ONLY open blocker is backend contact_requests 403: main agent should (1) add response.ok check + error toast in DriverSupportPage.handleSendContact AND (2) create a non-admin endpoint (e.g. POST /api/support/contact) or allow driver/user role on existing one. Re-run contact flow after fix: expect 200/201 + DB row in admin_contact_requests.
rca of the issue: Root cause: DriverSupportPage (contact section) POSTs to /api/admin/crud/contact_requests, but /app/backend/routes/admin.py::create_crud_item calls require_role(request,['admin']) (line 251). A driver-authenticated cookie fails that check -> 403. Frontend's try/catch only catches thrown network errors, so a 403 still falls through to toast.success(). Reproduction: login as driver -> /chauffeur/support/contact -> fill textarea -> click Envoyer -> network tab shows 403 on /api/admin/crud/contact_requests but UI shows 'Message envoye !'. Mitigation: add status check in frontend; add a public/driver-accessible endpoint server-side, or extend allowed roles.
